findings.body: After the first doctor fix merges and its local branch and folder are removed, the next repair recreates `fix/forge-files` and the same fix record. New evidence relevant to the fixed-branch ruling is the unchanged caller contract: `src/forge/close.py:341–346` selects any merged pull request with that branch name, and lines 73–77 return success immediately. Consequently, `forge close forge-files` reports the previous pull request as merged without reviewing or publishing the new repair. Likewise, `src/forge/board.py:76–91` and lines 227–230 classify the reused record as finished. Retain the fixed-name rule, but make these callers distinguish the current repair from an earlier merged repair. Add a real-command repair → merge → cleanup → repair → close test; the retention tests do not exercise this lifecycle.
findings.title: Not done: Doctor brings Forge's files up to date through a fix
